_comment: Curated urgent-help resources. Each entry was checked against its official page with curl on 2026-11-28 (see verified_note). Add an entry only after fetching its official source_url and finding the number/URL there. Languages are recorded only when the source states them.

resources.name: 112 India (national emergency number)
resources.who_for: Anyone in immediate danger or an emergency: police, fire, ambulance
resources.languages: not stated on the source page
resources.verified_note: Ministry of Home Affairs home page carries the official 'Dial 112' banner. 112.gov.in itself failed TLS verification from curl, so it is not used as a source.

resources.name: Elderline (National Helpline for Senior Citizens)
resources.who_for: Senior citizens: information, guidance, help with abuse, neglect or being left without support
resources.languages: not stated on the source page
resources.verified_note: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment) home page lists 'Elderline - National Helpline for Senior Citizens' with tel:14567.

resources.name: Tele-MANAS (national mental health helpline)
resources.who_for: Anyone in emotional distress, with thoughts of self-harm, or needing mental health support; free
resources.languages: multiple regional languages across states and UTs
resources.verified_note: Tele MANAS site (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare): 'toll-free, 24x7 mental health support', 'Callers dial Tele MANAS toll-free number 14416', services in multiple regional languages.

resources.name: Women Helpline 181
resources.who_for: Women facing violence, abuse or in distress
resources.languages: not stated on the source page
resources.verified_note: Ministry of Women and Child Development home page header lists 'Women Helpline Toll free No. - 181'.

resources.name: Child Helpline 1098
resources.who_for: Children in need of care or protection, or anyone reporting a child in distress
resources.languages: not stated on the source page
resources.verified_note: Ministry of Women and Child Development home page header lists 'Child Helpline Toll free No. - 1098'.

resources.name: Shelter for Urban Homeless (DAY-NULM, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)
resources.who_for: People without a home in towns and cities: a state-wise list of shelters; shelter staff are meant to help homeless people get ID proof, ration/BPL cards, pensions and bank accounts
resources.languages: not stated on the source page
resources.verified_note: nulm.gov.in (DAY-NULM, MoHUA) lists the shelter reports; the official SUH guidelines say shelters provide entitlements convergence: 'Identity Proof & Postal Address', 'Old age, widows and disability pensions', 'BPL cards, PDS ration cards', 'Bank ... Jan Dhan Yojana Accounts'.
